defaultnice.description: Nice level for jobs not matched in and.priorities.

interval.description: Time interval between renice cycles, in seconds.

lv1time.description: CPU time threshold (seconds) for first-level renice.

lv2time.description: CPU time threshold (seconds) for second-level renice.

lv3time.description: CPU time threshold (seconds) for third-level renice.

affinity.description: Order of priority lookup: permutation of 'c'ommand, 'g'roup, 'u'ser.

minuid.description: Minimum user ID considered for renicing (root 0 always ignored).

mingid.description: Minimum group ID considered for renicing.
